# Workflow steps that are not one task, each with why (go tool taskgate -allow).
#
# Task is installed from its pin in versions.yaml, so the step that reads the pin runs before there
# is a Task. Task as a go.mod tool would have none, but go-tools is a library: its tools' modules
# would be in the module graph of every repository that imports it.
.github/workflows/ci.yml/gate/Task's pin  # read before Task is installed
.github/workflows/pages.yml/build/Task's pin  # read before Task is installed
